title: Gas Pumps, Bridges & Tax Troubles in Austin
summary:
*   **Infrastructure Improvements:** Approved plans for significant upgrades on Guadalupe Street and formally accepted a newly completed concrete bridge on East 15th Street.
*   **Pioneering Gas Station Rules:** Issued a detailed permit for Hup Motor Sales Company to install an underground gasoline tank and curb-side pump, setting early regulations for urban fuel sales and public safety.
*   **Clarifying Tax Responsibility:** Resolved a property tax dispute by separating personal property taxes from land ownership, ensuring fair payment for the M.K.& T. Land Company.
*   **Reviewing Court Judgments:** Remitted fines for two individuals and significantly reduced a vagrancy fine by over 70%.

January 22nd 1917:

The Mayor laid before the Council the following resolution: Whereas, in view of the facts
set forth in the attached affidavit of G M Shipe, Secretary of the M K & T Land Co of
Austin, Texas, that J A Paddleford rendered for City taxes for 1915, Lots 23 & 24, Block 1
Hyde Park Addition No2, City of Austin, Texas, and at the same time rendered personal
property in the amount of nine hundred ($900.00) dollars ;and Whereas, it appears from the
same affidavit ,which the City Council believes to be correct, that the said J A
Paddleford did not own said Lots 23 & 24 ,Block 1, Hyde Park Addition No 2, City of
Austin, Texas, for the year 1915; and Whereas, the said M K & T Land Company desires to
pay the taxes on said Lots 23 & 24, Block 1 Hyde Park Addition No 2, XXXXXXXXXXX City of
Austin, Texas, but not the taxes on the personal property assessed against the said J A
Paddleford in connexion with said lots 23 & 24, Block No 1 Hyde Park Addition No 2, as
they are in no sense a proper charge against said property, Now, Therefore, Be it resolved
by the City Council of the City of Austin, Texas : That the charge of taxes against said
personal property of the said J A Paddleford for the year 1915 be and the same are hereby
declared to be no lien on said property and not a proper charge against the same ,and the
Assessor & Col -lector of the City of Austin, Texas, be and he is hereby authorized to
accept of the said M K & T Land Company the taxes on lots 23 & 24 ,Block 1 Hyde Park
Addition No 2, for the year 1915, and to look alone to the said J A Paddleford for the
taxes on his personal property for the year 1915.
The resolution was adopted by the following vote: Yeas Mayor Wooldridge, Councilmen
Anthony, Bartholomew, Haynes & Powell 5 Nays none.

Approved, A P Wooldridge, Mayor.
